_: Shared under every _support-<slug>.json. Same two-layer merge the product pages use (HANDOFF §22b), and the same rule: a key set in the page file wins outright.
_pages: The four support pages, in the order they are useful. build.py turns this into each page's sibling row minus itself, so adding a fifth support page needs one entry here and nothing in four editorial files.

pages.name: Returns
pages.hook: Sixty days on a club, thirty on everything else, and what condition it has to come back in.

pages.name: Shipping
pages.hook: When it leaves, when it lands, and what it costs to get it to you.

pages.name: Contact
pages.hook: The two ways to reach a person, and what to have in front of you when you do.

pages.name: FAQ
pages.hook: The questions golfers actually ask us, mostly in reviews, answered in one place.

moreAside: Anything here that reads as unclear is worth telling us about. It is easier to fix a sentence than to argue about it later.

close.headline: Talk to a person
close.body: If the answer isn't on this page, it's faster to ask than to guess. Chat is open on the site and email goes to a real inbox.
close.aside: Have your order number ready. It turns a two-day thread into one reply.
